request.description:
Create an activity with form-data. You can send new tasks, existing task_ids, or both.

Required:
- project_id={{project_id}}
- responsible_by={{admin_user_id}}
- title=Development

Optional:
- tasks=[{"title":"Build member dashboard widgets","description":"Create dashboard widgets from activity form-data","type_id":6,"status_id":1,"priority_id":3,"start_date":"2026-05-01","end_date":"2026-05-10"}]
- New task items do not need project_id or activity_id. The API uses the activity project and created activity automatically.
- type_id/status_id/priority_id are the same numeric lookup fields as create-task.
- task_ids=["{{task_id}}"] or {{task_id}} for one task
- start_date=2026-05-01
- end_date=2026-05-10
- achieve=0 and pin=0 are optional. Do not send them if you want default false.
- image=(file)

Behavior:
- Existing task_ids in the same project are attached to this activity.
- Existing task_ids from another accessible project are duplicated into this project/activity.
- Duplicate ids in task_ids are accepted.
- New task items default achieve=false and pin=false when omitted.
- Boolean inputs use 1=true and 0=false for activity achieve/pin.
